title: Wear Allowance on a Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease for a Paid-Off Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Contract
content:
**Relationship schedule — tenure addition to lease-end wear forgiveness**

This schedule applies to the turn-in of a Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease and reads the customer's paid-in-full Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.

**Clause.** The wear forgiveness tenure addition is $200 (the long-tenure addition) when the customer holds a paid-in-full Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract whose payments made count is at least 48 (the long-tenure payment count); it is $100 (the mid-tenure addition) when that count is at least 24 (the mid-tenure payment count) but below 48; and it is nothing when the customer holds no paid-in-full Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract or its count is below 24. Where the customer's retail records list more than one paid-in-full contract, the first one listed is the one read. The addition is added to the wear forgiveness cap of the turn-in before the wear forgiveness is measured against that enlarged limit.

| Paid-in-full new-vehicle retail contract (first listed) | Payments made count | Tenure addition |
|---|---|---|
| held | 60 | $200 |
| held | 48 | $200 |
| held | 47 | $100 |
| held | 24 | $100 |
| held | 23 | nothing |
| none held (only an active retail contract, or none at all) | — | nothing |

**Hypothetical illustration**: a lessee whose earlier Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract shows paid in full after 60 payments turns a lease in with a wear forgiveness cap of $250; the cap becomes $450 before the forgiveness is measured.
